views.name: artist_sales
views.body_sql: SELECT a.Name AS artist, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS total_sales FROM artists a JOIN albums ab ON a.ArtistId = ab.ArtistId JOIN tracks t ON ab.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId GROUP BY a.Name
views.description: total sales amount aggregated per artist

views.name: filtered_purchases
views.body_sql:
SELECT c.FirstName AS customer_first_name, ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity AS amount_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
JOIN invoice_items ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
views.description: joins customer first names and purchase amounts with the top-selling artist, filtered by a specified amount threshold
